# JustAnswer

> > Connect with verified lawyers and legal experts across multiple jurisdictions for instant online legal advice and answers to your legal questions.

JustAnswer is an online platform that connects users with verified lawyers and legal experts across multiple countries including the United States, Canada, Australia, United Kingdom, and other jurisdictions. The platform specializes in providing real-time legal consultation and answers to legal questions across various practice areas.

## Legal Services

- [Ask a Lawyer. Get Answers from Verified Lawyers.](https://www.justanswer.com/law/): Connect with verified lawyers for legal advice across multiple jurisdictions and legal practice areas.
